definitions.explanation: The common spice made from dried peppercorns, used as a seasoning in cooking. Includes black pepper, white pepper, etc.

examples.japanese: {胡椒|こしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{胡椒|こしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Season the soup with salt and pepper.

examples.japanese: {粗挽|あらび}き{胡椒|こしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}りかける→振りかける：21485_furikakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: Sprinkling coarsely ground pepper on steak enhances the flavor.

notes:
TYPES:
- {黒|くろ}{胡椒|こしょう}: black pepper
- {白|しろ}{胡椒|こしょう}: white pepper
- {粗挽|あらび}き{胡椒|こしょう}: coarsely ground pepper
- ⟦{山椒|さんしょう}→山椒：12412_sanshou⟧: Japanese pepper (different plant, Sichuan pepper family)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩|しお}{胡椒|こしょう}: salt and pepper
- {胡椒|こしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to sprinkle pepper
- {胡椒|こしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挽|ひ}く→挽く：12794_hiku⟧: to grind pepper

NOTE: Not to be confused with ⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧ (breakdown, malfunction), which is a homophone.
